name: What is a rental property exit strategy?

mainEntity.name: What is a rental property exit strategy?

acceptedAnswer.text: A rental property exit strategy is a predefined plan for how and when you will sell or otherwise divest your investment property. It outlines the circumstances under which you will sell, such as reaching a specific profit margin, responding to market changes, or achieving personal financial goals. Developing an exit strategy early helps maximize returns and minimize potential losses by guiding decisions throughout your ownership, especially in competitive markets like Miami-Dade County.
acceptedAnswer.description: A rental property exit strategy is a predefined plan for how and when you will sell or divest an investment property, helping guide decisions and maximize returns.
